data.name: Description
data.value: GitHub Actions report generator to emit workflow commands so test runs produce a first-class experience on GitHub Actions.

data.name: AnnotationsOptionDescription
data.value: Enable or disable GitHub Actions annotations for failed and skipped tests. Valid values are 'on' (also accepts 'true', 'enable', '1') or 'off' (also accepts 'false', 'disable', '0'). Defaults to 'on' when running on GitHub Actions.
data.comment: {Locked="on"}{Locked="off"}{Locked="true"}{Locked="enable"}{Locked="1"}{Locked="false"}{Locked="disable"}{Locked="0"}

data.name: AnnotationTitle
data.value: Test failed: {0}
data.comment: {0} is the fully qualified test name.

data.name: SkippedAnnotationTitle
data.value: Test skipped: {0}
data.comment: {0} is the fully qualified test name.

data.name: NoFailureMessageFallback
data.value: The test failed without providing a failure message.

data.name: NoSkipReasonFallback
data.value: The test was skipped without providing a reason.

data.name: StepSummaryOptionDescription
data.value: Control writing a markdown job summary to the GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY file. Valid values are 'on' (also accepts 'true', 'enable', '1'), 'off' (also accepts 'false', 'disable', '0'), or 'on-failure' to write only when the test invocation fails. Defaults to 'on' when running on GitHub Actions.
data.comment: {Locked="'on'"}{Locked="'off'"}{Locked="'true'"}{Locked="'enable'"}{Locked="'1'"}{Locked="'false'"}{Locked="'disable'"}{Locked="'0'"}{Locked="'on-failure'"}{Locked="GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"}

data.name: StepSummarySectionsOptionDescription
data.value: Select the content included in the GitHub Actions job summary. Specify one or more values, repeated, space-separated, or comma-separated: 'test-results', 'slow-tests', 'coverage', or 'all'. Defaults to 'all'. Requires '--report-gh'.
data.comment: {Locked="'test-results'"}{Locked="'slow-tests'"}{Locked="'coverage'"}{Locked="'all'"}{Locked="'--report-gh'"}

data.name: EmptyStepSummarySections
data.value: At least one GitHub Actions job-summary section is required. Valid values are 'test-results', 'slow-tests', 'coverage', or 'all'.
data.comment: {Locked="'test-results'"}{Locked="'slow-tests'"}{Locked="'coverage'"}{Locked="'all'"}

data.name: InvalidStepSummarySection
data.value: Invalid GitHub Actions job-summary section '{0}'. Valid values are 'test-results', 'slow-tests', 'coverage', or 'all'. Values can be repeated, space-separated, or comma-separated.
data.comment: {0} is the invalid section name. {Locked="'test-results'"}{Locked="'slow-tests'"}{Locked="'coverage'"}{Locked="'all'"}

data.name: StepSummaryWriteFailedWarning
data.value: Failed to write the GitHub Actions job summary to '{0}': {1}
data.comment: {0} is the file path, {1} is the error message.

data.name: SlowTestNoticesOptionDescription
data.value: Enable or disable GitHub Actions slow-test notices. Valid values are 'on' (also accepts 'true', 'enable', '1') or 'off' (also accepts 'false', 'disable', '0'). Defaults to 'on' when running on GitHub Actions.
data.comment: {Locked="on"}{Locked="off"}{Locked="true"}{Locked="enable"}{Locked="1"}{Locked="false"}{Locked="disable"}{Locked="0"}

data.name: SlowTestThresholdOptionDescription
data.value: The duration a test may run before a GitHub Actions slow-test notice is emitted. Accepts a bare number of seconds or a value with a unit suffix such as '90s', '2m', or '1.5h'. Defaults to 60s.
data.comment: {Locked="s"}{Locked="m"}{Locked="h"}

data.name: SlowTestNoticeTitle
data.value: Slow test: {0}
data.comment: {0} is the fully qualified test name.

data.name: SlowTestStillRunning
data.value: {0} still running after {1}s
data.comment: {0} is the fully qualified test name, {1} is the elapsed seconds.

data.name: InvalidSlowTestThreshold
data.value: Invalid value '{0}'. The slow-test threshold must be a positive duration, e.g. '60', '90s', or '2m'.
data.comment: {Locked="s"}{Locked="m"}

data.name: DisplayName
data.value: GitHub Actions report generator

data.name: GroupTitle
data.comment: {0} is the assembly name, {1} is the target framework moniker.

data.name: GroupsOptionDescription
data.value: Enable or disable per-assembly log groups. Valid values are 'on' (also accepts 'true', 'enable', '1') or 'off' (also accepts 'false', 'disable', '0'). Defaults to 'on' when running on GitHub Actions.
data.comment: {Locked="on"}{Locked="off"}{Locked="true"}{Locked="enable"}{Locked="1"}{Locked="false"}{Locked="disable"}{Locked="0"}

data.name: HistoryOptionDescription
data.value: Read and update a bounded GitHub Actions test history snapshot at the specified path. The workflow is responsible for downloading the prior snapshot before the test run and uploading the updated file afterward. Requires '--report-gh'.
data.comment: {Locked="'--report-gh'"}

data.name: HistoryWindowOptionDescription
data.value: Number of days of test history to retain and use for flaky-test context (1-90). Defaults to 30. Requires '--report-gh-history'.
data.comment: {Locked="'--report-gh-history'"}

data.name: InvalidHistoryWindow
data.value: Invalid GitHub Actions test history window '{0}'. Specify a whole number of days from 1 through 90.
data.comment: {0} is the invalid history window.

data.name: InvalidHistoryPath
data.value: The GitHub Actions test history snapshot path must be a valid, non-empty path.

data.name: HistoryWindowRequiresHistory
data.value: The '--report-gh-history-window' option requires '--report-gh-history' to be specified.
data.comment: {Locked="'--report-gh-history-window'"}{Locked="'--report-gh-history'"}

data.name: HistoryLoadFailedWarning
data.value: Failed to load the GitHub Actions test history snapshot from '{0}': {1}
data.comment: {0} is the snapshot path, {1} is the error message.

data.name: HistoryWriteFailedWarning
data.value: Failed to write the GitHub Actions test history snapshot to '{0}': {1}
data.comment: {0} is the snapshot path, {1} is the error message.

data.name: HistoryFailureContext
data.value: Historical context: failed {0} and flaked {1} of {2} prior runs within the {3}-day history window.
data.comment: {0} is the failure count, {1} is the flaky count, {2} is the total prior run count, {3} is the history window in days.

data.name: HistoryFlakyContext
data.value: Historical context: flaked {0} of {1} prior runs within the {2}-day history window.
data.comment: {0} is the flaky count, {1} is the total prior run count, {2} is the history window in days.

data.name: HistoryDurationContext
data.value: Historical duration: p95 {0}, p99 {1} across {2} prior samples.
data.comment: {0} is the p95 duration, {1} is the p99 duration, {2} is the duration sample count.

data.name: HistoryRegressionContext
data.value: Historical context: passed all {0} prior runs within the {1}-day history window.
data.comment: {0} is the total prior result count, {1} is the history window in days.

data.name: InvalidOnOffValue
data.value: Invalid value '{0}'. Valid values are 'on' (or 'true', 'enable', '1') or 'off' (or 'false', 'disable', '0').
data.comment: {Locked="on"}{Locked="off"}{Locked="true"}{Locked="enable"}{Locked="1"}{Locked="false"}{Locked="disable"}{Locked="0"}

data.name: InvalidStepSummaryValue
data.value: Invalid value '{0}'. Valid values are 'on' (or 'true', 'enable', '1'), 'off' (or 'false', 'disable', '0'), or 'on-failure'.
data.comment: {Locked="'on'"}{Locked="'off'"}{Locked="'true'"}{Locked="'enable'"}{Locked="'1'"}{Locked="'false'"}{Locked="'disable'"}{Locked="'0'"}{Locked="'on-failure'"}{0} is the invalid value.

data.name: SubOptionsRequireReportGh
data.value: The GitHub Actions report sub-options require '--{0}' to be specified.
data.comment: Validation error when a sub-option is used without the report option. {0} is the report option name. {Locked="'--{0}'"}

data.name: OptionDescription
data.value: Enable GitHub Actions report generator to emit workflow commands so test runs produce a first-class experience on GitHub Actions.

data.name: ExitCodeCallout
data.value: Exit code {0} — {1}: {2}
data.comment: {0} is the numeric exit code, {1} is the exit code name (not localized), {2} is the reason. Rendered as a callout in the job summary.

data.name: ExitCodeAnnotationTitle
data.value: Test run failed (exit code {0}: {1})
data.comment: {0} is the numeric exit code, {1} is the exit code name (not localized).

data.name: ExitCodeReasonSuccess

data.name: ExitCodeReasonGenericFailure
data.value: The test run failed.

data.name: ExitCodeReasonAtLeastOneTestFailed
data.value: At least one test failed.

data.name: ExitCodeReasonTestSessionAborted
data.value: The test session was aborted.

data.name: ExitCodeReasonInvalidPlatformSetup
data.value: The test platform setup is invalid.

data.name: ExitCodeReasonInvalidCommandLine
data.value: The command line arguments are invalid.

data.name: ExitCodeReasonTestHostProcessExitedNonGracefully
data.value: The test host process exited non-gracefully.

data.name: ExitCodeReasonZeroTests
data.value: No tests were found to run. This often means a test filter matched nothing.

data.name: ExitCodeReasonMinimumExpectedTestsPolicyViolation
data.value: Fewer tests ran than required by --minimum-expected-tests.

data.name: ExitCodeReasonTestAdapterTestSessionFailure

data.name: ExitCodeReasonDependentProcessExited

data.name: ExitCodeReasonIncompatibleProtocolVersion
data.value: An incompatible protocol version was negotiated.

data.name: ExitCodeReasonTestExecutionStoppedForMaxFailedTests
data.value: Test execution stopped after reaching the limit set by --maximum-failed-tests.
data.comment: {Locked="--maximum-failed-tests"}

data.name: ExitCodeReasonCoverageThresholdFailed
data.value: One or more code coverage thresholds were not met.

data.name: ExitCodeReasonTestExecutionStoppedAtDeadline

data.name: ExitCodeReasonUnknown
data.value: The test run reported a non-success exit code.

data.name: FailureDetailsOptionDescription
data.value: Enable or disable expanding each failed test in the job summary into a collapsible section with its failure message, exception type, source location and stack trace. Valid values are 'on' (also accepts 'true', 'enable', '1') or 'off' (also accepts 'false', 'disable', '0'). Defaults to 'on' when running on GitHub Actions.
data.comment: {Locked="'on'"}{Locked="'off'"}{Locked="'true'"}{Locked="'enable'"}{Locked="'1'"}{Locked="'false'"}{Locked="'disable'"}{Locked="'0'"}

data.name: FailureDetailExceptionLabel
data.value: Exception
data.comment: Label preceding the exception type of a failed test in the job summary.

data.name: FailureDetailLocationLabel
data.value: Location
data.comment: Label preceding the source file and line of a failed test in the job summary.

data.name: FailureDetailTruncated
data.value: [... truncated]
data.comment: Marker appended to a failure message or stack trace that was clipped to fit the job summary size limit.

data.name: FailureListTruncated
data.value: Showing the first {0} of {1} failed tests. See the workflow log or the test report for the remaining failures.
data.comment: {0} is the number of listed failures, {1} is the total number of failed tests.

data.name: FailureDetailsOmitted
data.value: Failure details for {0} listed test(s) were omitted because the error details take up too much space.
data.comment: {0} is the number of failures rendered without their expanded diagnostics.

data.name: ModuleDetailsOmitted
data.value: Failure details were omitted for {0} of {1} test project(s) because the error details already take up too much space. See the workflow log or the test report for their full diagnostics.
data.comment: {0} is the number of test projects rendered without expanded failure diagnostics, {1} is the total number of test projects.

data.name: SummaryCondensed
data.value: condensed to one line because the summary already takes up too much space. See the workflow log or the test report for full results.
data.comment: Appended to a single-line test project verdict when the shared job summary file is close to GitHub's size limit.

data.name: SummaryTruncatedNotice
data.value: This job summary was getting long, so it was shortened: it contains the full results of the first {0} test project(s), and the ones reported below as a single line had their results left out. GitHub discards a job summary larger than 1 MB in full rather than shortening it. See the workflow log or the test report for the complete results.
data.comment: Note placed at the top of the job summary once its size forces whole test project sections to be replaced by a one-line verdict. {0} is the number of test projects whose full results are in the summary. "1 MB" is GitHub's documented job summary size limit.

data.name: ModulesNotListed
data.value: {0} further test project(s) are not listed because the job summary size limit was reached. GitHub discards a job summary larger than 1 MB in full rather than shortening it. See the workflow log or the test report for their results.
data.comment: Replaces the remaining test project verdicts once the combined job summary is close to GitHub's size limit. {0} is the number of test projects left out. "1 MB" is GitHub's documented job summary size limit.

data.name: StepSummaryLimitExceededWarning
data.value: The GitHub job summary file is {0} bytes and appending this report section would exceed the {1}-byte limit GitHub enforces per step. GitHub discards an oversized job summary in full rather than truncating it, so appending would have lost every section, including those other test projects already wrote. This section was skipped to keep the rest of the summary intact. This usually means many test projects, or other tools, are writing to the same job summary; see the workflow log or the test report for these results.
data.comment: {0} is the current size of the job summary file in bytes, {1} is the limit in bytes.
